verdict.rationale: Unreal documents a first-party Automation Test Framework for unit, feature and content stress testing, with smoke tests that run when the Editor, game or commandlet starts. It also documents Gauntlet for running engine sessions that execute tests and validate results across platforms, and Unreal Automation Tool as a generic system for automating testing and builds, so in-engine tests can be driven from CI. missing for 10: explicit documentation that tests run with rendering disabled (headless) in CI, a documented CI-integration walkthrough for test runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
